notes:
A big update since 1.49, mostly for stamps, pistons and two-tablet playing.

**Stamp sizes are pictures now.** The size button on every stamp tool shows the actual stamps at each size, instead of the words Small, Medium and Large. There is also a fourth, larger size. The pencil and highlighter sizes lose their labels too: the line is the size.

**Pistons for organs with a lot of generals.** Three-digit piston numbers now shrink to fit inside the triangle. An organ's Piston layout has a new option, **This organ has memory levels**: untick it for a console with one bank of generals and no levels, and the piston editor stops asking about levels. When a bank has more than 30 pistons, you type the number on a number pad, and piston 0 is allowed. The list of organs in the piston editor also has larger text.

**Importing from Google Drive or Dropbox shows an Importing window** while the file downloads, so it no longer looks frozen.

**Library text has a new Giant size**, one step above Huge.

**Sending a piece to another tablet** no longer asks whether to delete pieces the other tablet has removed, and it finishes by saying "Sent." The questions and the finished screen at the end of a sync now match the rest of the redesigned Sync panel.

**Ink removed with Clear Page stays removed.** It used to come back after a Library Sync.

**Hiding Full-Width Page** in the sidebar settings now really hides it.

**Fixed a crash** when a piece with very large pages was set to start on the right-hand tablet.

**If you use two tablets together:**

- **Ghosting on the tablet you are not touching is fixed**, using a new setting called **Obbligato panel wake**. While two tablets are connected and it is off, Obbligato explains how to turn it on.
- **Stamp sizes and the note or rest you have chosen** now carry over to the other tablet.
- **The turning logo on the second tablet** now shows the name of the piece that is arriving, and it no longer gets stuck on.
- **The brightness meter** no longer flashes up when the tablets connect.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
